mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, u.nickname, u.profile_img, u.grade, NVL(l.count_likes, 0) AS countLikes FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.writer = u.userid
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cmtno, COUNT(*) AS count_likes FROM comment_likes GROUP BY cmtno ) l ON c.cmtno = l.cmtno WHERE c.postno = #{postNo} ORDER BY c.created_at
mapper.insert:
SELECT comments_seq.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO comments VALUES( #{cmtNo}, #{postNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{writer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{text, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, NULL, 0)
